title: Sent Eastward to the Land of the East

request.style: English, warm male solo voice with soft choir backing, acoustic guitar, banjo, fiddle, gentle percussion, melancholic and storytelling, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Abraham took another wife named Keturah
She bore him sons of a different line
Midian was born before the end came
One of the six who were his

[Verse]
He gave everything he owned to Isaac
But to the sons of his concubines he gave gifts
While he was still alive he sent them away
Eastward to the land of the east

[Chorus]
Sent eastward to the land of the east
Away from the inheritance of Isaac
To the sons of his concubines he gave gifts
A separate path in the eastern light

[Verse]
Ephah and Epher and Hanoch too
Abida and Eldaah are named
The sons of Midian were the children
Of Keturah in the ancient days

[Chorus]
Sent eastward to the land of the east
Away from the inheritance of Isaac
To the sons of his concubines he gave gifts
A separate path in the eastern light

[Bridge]
All these were the sons of Keturah
Recorded in the books of Chronicles
Midian the ancestor of the clans
Lived in the areas south and east

[Chorus]
Sent eastward to the land of the east
Away from the inheritance of Isaac
To the sons of his concubines he gave gifts
A separate path in the eastern light

[Outro]
Eastward to the land of the east
Sent away while he was still alive
